Motherwell face Hibernian at Fir Park in round 15 of the Premiership. The bookmakers’ odds offered on this match give Motherwell a 36% win probability and Hibernian a 37% probability, leaving little between the teams.

Current Form - Motherwell

Motherwell are 11th on 13 points after 14 league matches, with three wins, four draws and seven losses and a 16-23 goal record. Their last league match ended in a 1-2 home loss to Rangers. Across their last five matches, Motherwell have recorded one win, two draws and two losses; they scored 1.0 goal per match and conceded 1.4, compared with season averages of 1.1 and 1.6.

Current Form - Hibernian

Hibernian sit ninth on 14 points after 14 league matches, with four wins, two draws and eight losses and a 17-22 goal record. Their last league match was a 2-1 home win over Dundee FC. Their last five matches brought two wins, one draw and two losses, while their scoring average rose to 1.6 goals per match from 1.2 across the season; their conceded average remained 1.6.

Head-to-Head Record

Motherwell have won three and drawn two of their last five meetings against Hibernian, with an average of 1.6 goals per match. Motherwell won 2-1 at Hibernian earlier this season. Motherwell have won their last two meetings against Hibernian, going back to May 2026. Motherwell are unbeaten against Hibernian since November 2025, a run of three wins and two draws

For Motherwell, midfielder Lukas Fadinger has scored three goals, including two in his last five matches, while midfielder Tom Sparrow has recorded three assists. Defender Jake Girdwood-Reich has contributed one goal and one assist. Alex Lowry, who has three goals and one assist this season, is a doubt for this match. Dylan Williams and Johnny Koutroumbis are unavailable.

Hibernian’s leading scorer is forward Martin Boyle, with four goals, while midfielder Callum Wright has three goals and one assist. Midfielder Nicky Cadden has scored two goals, all in his last five matches. Felix Passlack, Nathan Lowe and Kanayochukwu Megwa are unavailable.
